# California Teachers Association

> CTA is a 310,000-member teachers union advocating for public education, educator rights, and professional development across California.

The California Teachers Association (CTA) represents classroom teachers, education support professionals, and aspiring educators throughout California. The organization provides comprehensive resources including professional development, legal services, member benefits, and advocacy support for improving public education and protecting educator rights.

## Key Topics

- California Teachers Association
- Educator Rights
- Professional Development

## Educator Membership & Enrollment

- [Join - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/membership/join): Membership enrollment page for joining CTA and accessing union benefits
- [For Educators - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators): Main hub for educator resources, union membership, and professional development
- [Meet CTA - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/meet-cta): Overview of CTA organization, membership categories, and educator advocacy mission

## Educator Categories & Support

- [Classroom Teachers - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/meet-cta/classroom-teachers): Information for classroom teachers in California schools serving 6M+ students
- [Education Support Professionals - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/meet-cta/esp): Information for education support professionals and whole-child student wellness
- [New Educators - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/new-educators): Resources for new teachers including rights, lesson plans, and professional support
- [Become a Teacher - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/become-a-teacher): Guide to becoming an educator in California with credentials and resources

## Professional Development & Instruction

- [Instruction and Professional Development (IPD) - CTA](https://www.cta.org/ipd): Professional development programs covering standards, assessment, curriculum, and instruction

## Rights, Legal Services & Advocacy

- [Your Rights - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/your-rights): Information on educator employment rights, workplace safety, and legal protections
- [Legal Services - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/member-benefits/legal-services): Legal services protecting educator rights and providing liability insurance coverage

## Member Benefits & Recognition

- [Member Benefits - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/member-benefits): Overview of exclusive CTA member benefits including discounts and legal services
- [Discounts and Travel - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/member-benefits/discounts-and-travel): Travel and retail discounts for CTA members via partner organizations
- [Scholarships, Grants, and Awards - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/for-educators/scholarships-awards): Scholarships, grants, and awards recognizing educators and public education advocates

## News & Publications

- [California Educator - California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org/educator): Award-winning bimonthly magazine covering education policy, advocacy, and union activities

## Optional

- [California Teachers Association](https://www.cta.org): Homepage for CTA, 310,000-member teachers union advocating for public education
